versionProbe.title: CLI version
versionProbe.hint: Optional: run the selected CLI only after confirmation. Automatic discovery never runs it.
versionProbe.requiresDiscovery: Rediscover a found entry first; unsaved path changes and browser preview cannot launch it.
versionProbe.warning: This starts the program shown above, not a sandbox. Even --version can read user configuration or credentials, load plugins, access the network, write files, or start other processes/containers. A found path does not prove the program is genuine. Proceed only if you trust this entry.
versionProbe.limits: Only --version is passed; stdin is closed, each output pipe is limited to 8 KiB, and the direct child has a 5-second deadline. Termination targets the direct child only; descendants and side effects may remain. Raw output is not displayed or logged. Windows requires a native .exe, not a .cmd/.bat wrapper.
versionProbe.evidence: Reported by the user-triggered CLI command. This does not verify authenticity, capabilities, connection or effective configuration.

precedence.claudeCode: Observed user settings root only. Managed, project, local and CLI settings may override it; ~/.claude.json and project files are not inspected. Configuration deployment is not implemented.
precedence.codex: Observed user config root only (CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex). Profiles, trusted project, system, managed and CLI settings may change effective behavior. Configuration deployment is not implemented.
precedence.openCode: Observed candidate config root only. OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR semantics differ by version; file, inline, remote and project configuration is not inspected. Effective settings and deployment support are unverified.
precedence.hermes: Observed CLI user-data root only. HERMES_HOME, profiles, managed settings, environment and CLI options may change effective behavior; desktop bundles can use a different root. Configuration deployment is not implemented.
precedence.pi: Documented precedence: trusted project settings / MCP can override user settings. Models are user-level; CLI, SDK, extensions and existing sessions may change effective behavior.
precedence.grokBuild: Documented precedence: system managed → user managed → user config → user requirements → system requirements. Trusted project MCP / plugins / permissions and CLI or sessions may change effective behavior.
